# nest

concise context for llm coding agents working in this repository.

## project snapshot

- language stack: rust workspace + python tooling.
- product: single-file .nest format, mmap runtime, cli, and pyo3 bindings.
- architecture docs: doc/arc/arc.md and doc/arc/arc.yaml are the source of truth.

## build and verification

- cargo build --workspace
- cargo build --release --workspace
- cargo test --workspace
- cargo fmt --all --check
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
- ./scripts/release_check.sh

prefer release_check.sh before merge, it is the project gate.

## coding practices

- rust edition 2024, resolver 3.
- no panic in library code, use typed errors.
- keep files small and single-responsibility.
- preserve deterministic behavior for hashing and index builds.
- for unsafe blocks, include a safety comment naming the invariant.
- keep markdown lowercase, no emoji, no em dash.

## format and runtime invariants

- format v1 is frozen.
- hash format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
- content_hash must stay stable across non-semantic encodings.
- search score contract is cosine with exact rerank for ann/hybrid paths.

## dataset policy

- dat/corpus_next.v1.nest is tracked with git lfs.
- dat/demo datasets are local-only and gitignored.
- dataset fetch commands and provenance are documented in dat/demo/README.md.

## branch and release flow

- feature work targets dev (or feature branches based on dev).
- release flow is dev to main.
- main may enforce pr-only updates and required checks.

## do not

- do not force-push main.
- do not bypass release_check.sh.
- do not bump NEST_FORMAT_VERSION for additive changes.
- do not commit local demo datasets under dat/demo.
